name: Tejas Singh
alt: Tejas Singh playing an acoustic guitar on a fire escape, in black and white.
blurb: Authentic and intimate with a specialty in building familiar songs from the ground up with his amazing ear and looping tech, Tejas brings a wide variety of fan favorite songs and is also available to play his original, singer-songwriter material to your event.
seo_title: Tejas Singh: cover band for weddings and private events in Denver
meta_description: Tejas Singh plays covers for private events in Denver and the Colorado mountains. Book a duo for cocktails or a quartet for the dance floor. Send us your date.
identity: You can book Tejas as a duo, a trio or a quartet. That makes it easy to keep one act for your whole event.
For instance, he can start out as a duo, and then the rest of the band can join him when it's time to dance.
The band keeps an eye on your guests and picks the next song to keep people dancing.

ladder.bestFor: The duo can work well for cocktails and dinner.
The trio is the one for a small venue, or for when you want a dance floor without a full band.

ladder.build: The trio plus keys or a second guitar
ladder.bestFor: Book the quartet when you want a lively dance floor at a wedding or a corporate party.
